name: University of Stavanger (UiS)
summary: Stavanger's university on Norway's west coast; its one English bachelor's is Dance, taught at the Bjergsted performing-arts campus.

handoff.label: Undergraduate programmes (Dance is the English one)

ib.text: Dance: the IB Diploma plus a two-round audition; no Norwegian needed. UiS's other bachelor's are taught in Norwegian and need Norwegian at B2, which Danish A at grade 3 covers.

apply.via: Søknadsweb (local admission, with a specification form)

dates.label: Dance: application opens in Søknadsweb (year assumed)
Dance: application and specification form deadline (year assumed)
Dance: round 1 audition video due (year assumed)

programmes.name: Dance – Bachelor
programmes.ib: Round 1 is a self-filmed video (ballet and contemporary); round 2 is three days of audition workshops and an interview in Stavanger in week 10.

notes: Still at school? With your 15 December application, upload your school's confirmation that you finish in spring, plus a preliminary transcript, as the dance page asks.
Student housing is across the street from the Bjergsted campus.
